description: This file defines React components for custom scroll area UI, utilizing the radix UI primitive components. It provides a ScrollArea component wrapping its children with custom scrollbar, and a ScrollBar component for vertical and horizontal scrollbars, with styling and forwarding refs.

methods.name: ScrollArea
methods.description: A React component wrapping radix UI's ScrollArea primitive, providing a custom scrollable viewport with optional additional styling and a scrollbar.

methods.name: ScrollBar
methods.description: A React component for rendering a scrollbar (vertical or horizontal) with customized styling, forwarding refs, and using radix UI primitives.
